about: Skill-selection bank (docs/SKILL-SELECTION-TESTS.md). Expectations are judged by a person with the skill files open, not derived from words in the prompt. Skill names are data: rename them here (or in `sets`) when a plugin renames a skill; bank.mjs refuses to load a URI that does not exist under plugins/lang-*/data/skills or plugins/skills-*/data/skills. `@name` in any URI list expands to `sets.name`; `*` in a URI is a glob. must = groups (each satisfied by any one URI in it; every group must be satisfied); may = neutral; anything else read is wasted; must_not reads are also counted as wrong reads.
